title: NexArb
tagline: Developing a ChatGPT plugin that leverages Chainlink's on-chain price oracle and Galadriel's computation for real-time trading data. It helps users identify and execute trades, even if they are inexperienced, with the results verified via the Sign Protocol.
description: This project aims to solve the limitations of ChatGPT in financial trading by creating a plugin that enables the platform to access external trading data and perform complex computations. Using Chainlink for real-time price data and Galadriel for on-chain computations, the plugin helps users identify trading opportunities. The target audience is people aged 20-45 who are interested in trading but lack the knowledge or tools to do so effectively. Once a user selects a trade, it is executed and verified through the Sign Protocol.
how_its_made:
The project integrates several technologies to create a seamless trading experience:

Chainlink: Used for gathering real-time trading data via its price oracle.
Galadriel: Handles complex computations, enabling the identification of trading opportunities.
Sign Protocol: Verifies the execution of trades. 

The system consists of a web app and a ChatGPT plugin. The app presents trade options to users, while the calculations are done on-chain.
